entities.summary: Olivier Robinson, "Olli", Nkamhoua is a Finnish professional basketball player for Pallacanestro Varese of the Lega Basket Serie A (LBA). He played college basketball for the Tennessee Volunteers and Michigan Wolverines. Nkamhoua is also part of the Finland national team. He began playing basketball with NMKY Helsinki.
